title: Work IQ: business skills for agents through Work IQ MCP
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, default-enablement exceptions, licensing and governance controls are supported by the record and Microsoft documentation. The flagged Dataverse API call is documented: the reference supports PATCH and exposes the writable Is Enabled property.

Business skills are natural-language instructions describing organisational processes.
claims.quote: Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done.

claims.claim: A skill describes the steps, required information and business rules for completing work.
claims.quote: Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.

claims.claim: Agents discover and use accessible business skills as needed at runtime through Work IQ MCP.
claims.quote: Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes.

claims.claim: Multiple agents using the same skill follow the same process.
claims.quote: When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your organization.

claims.claim: Business skills are stored in Dataverse.
claims.quote: Business skills are stored in Dataverse and follow Dataverse security patterns.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn describes business skills and the default settings as preview, subject to change.
claims.quote:
[This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done.

claims.claim: Default enablement for eligible new environments starts September 30, 2026.
claims.quote: Starting September 30, 2026, Microsoft turns on these capabilities by default for all new environments that aren't listed as exceptions in this article.

claims.claim: Default enablement for eligible existing environments starts in November 2026.
claims.quote: Starting in November 2026, Microsoft turns on Business Applications in Work IQ for existing environments that aren't listed as exceptions.

claims.claim: Default enablement applies to eligible public production environments.
claims.quote: The default applies to public production environments created for new or existing tenants. The following environments are exceptions:

claims.claim: EU and EFTA environments are exceptions to current default enablement.
claims.quote:
The following environments are exceptions:

- **European Union (EU) and European Free Trade Association (EFTA) environments**

claims.claim: Microsoft plans default enablement for EU and EFTA environments when the feature becomes generally available.
claims.quote: Microsoft plans to enable environments provisioned in the European Union (EU) and European Free Trade Association (EFTA) environments when the feature becomes generally available.

claims.claim: During public preview, EU and EFTA customers can turn on Work IQ using the corresponding Microsoft 365 admin center setting.
claims.quote: During public preview, customers can turn on Work IQ by using the corresponding setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Government-related environments are exceptions to default enablement.
claims.quote: **Government-related environments**: This exception applies to environments provisioned by customers with current or previous government cloud deployments that are likely to depend on FedRAMP security controls.

claims.claim: Trial, sandbox and developer environments are exceptions to default enablement.
claims.quote: **Nonproduction environments**: This exception applies to trial, sandbox, and developer environments.

claims.quote: To enable business skills in a Dataverse environment, a Power Platform administrator turns on **Work IQ**.

claims.quote: A Dataverse environment with **Work IQ** enabled by a Power Platform administrator.

claims.claim: Agent skill selection is probabilistic.
claims.quote: Agent selection is probabilistic, so test representative requests before you share a skill broadly.

claims.claim: Activating an updated skill makes its changed instructions available to agents.
claims.quote: **Save and activate** | Makes your changes the active version, including its associated resources. The previous active version remains in version history.

claims.claim: Saving a working copy alone does not change the active skill version agents use.
claims.quote: **Save** | Saves your working copy without changing the version agents use. A new skill remains inactive. If the skill already has an active version, that version stays active.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes
claims.claim: Business Applications in Work IQ cost is attributed to the consuming experience.
claims.quote: For Business Applications in Work IQ, you track cost by the experiences people use rather than by a dedicated business applications category.

claims.claim: Licensed chat business-data grounding is not separately charged as a Work IQ API interaction.
claims.quote: You don't pay extra for it as a Work IQ API interaction.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes

claims.claim: Skills can be used through Copilot, Work IQ-connected agents and agents directly connected to Dataverse MCP.

claims.claim: PATCH [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/allowedmcpclients({allowedmcpclientid}) with body {"isenabled": false} disables the selected allowed MCP client.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/allowedmcpclients; Primary key: allowedmcpclientid; Operations supported: POSTGETPATCHDELETE; isenabled | Edm.Boolean | Display name: Is Enabled; 1 | Yes; 0 | No

claims.claim: The tenant-wide Work IQ MCP server can be blocked in Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Block.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center.
2. Select **Agents** > **Tools**.

4. Review its current availability.

To block access to the server, select **Block**.
